items: Prior-auth requests bounced for evidence that existed in clinical notes; SLA breaches and provider revolt.
Claims codes and clinical narratives never reconciled; coding integrity audits painful.
Medical-policy grounding inconsistent across decision paths.

blocks.x: The prior-auth agent maps policy criteria to chart evidence, assembles submissions and appeals with citations, and routes true judgment calls to clinicians. Claims-clinical reconciliation on Forge now feeds coding-integrity and quality reporting with lineage; coverage decisions cite policy passages with provenance on Nexus.
